reason: Verify the original Gauss equation removed by a single potential gauge and the associated total-charge compatibility at every accepted A2P state
scope: All 18 electric/mechanical e15 positive/negative/zero states; physical material, BC, nonlinear solver and previous gates unchanged
raw_system: Reassemble the accepted seven-field state with the production residual/Jacobian and no Dirichlet row replacement. Do not use cached or already-replaced Newton rows.
row_normalization: s_i=max_j abs(J_original_ij)*field_scale_j, exactly equilibrate_csr_system using the same per-case field scales as Newton. No zero-field relative denominator, numerical floor, or replacement unit scale.

row_gates.electric: Maximum absolute scaled residual on free potential rows <= tolerance. Original outer Dirichlet rows are contact reactions, reported without a zero gate.
row_gates.mechanical: Maximum absolute scaled residual on every original potential row, including the gauge row, <= tolerance. Gauge-row error is also reported explicitly.
row_gates.relation_to_Newton: Per-row maximum is an additional stricter audit; no relaxation of the existing free-DOF RMS residual test.

total_charge.charge_integral: Independent order-five physical volume integral of material charge density
total_charge.partition_identity: Sum of all original Gauss residuals equals integral(rho), since the FE shape functions form a partition of unity
total_charge.normalization: S=sum_i s_i over all original potential rows, the algebraic absolute row-scale bound for the constant test function; not a target-charge or field-dependent zero denominator
total_charge.mechanical_compatibility_gate: abs(Qrho_5)/S <= 1e-11, alongside the individual all-row gate
total_charge.electric_scope: No extra zero-total-charge gate is imposed by Dirichlet contacts; integral and original reaction rows are reported.
total_charge.exterior_flux: Independently integrated D.n and D.n minus Qrho are reported in coulombs only. The algebraic 1e-11 gate does not replace the frozen spatial normal-flux criteria.

outputs: Per-case original Gauss row CSV with coordinates, constraint/gauge flags, raw residual, original row scale and normalized residual
acceptance: New Gauss compatibility gates are conjoined with every original A2P gate, including zero perturbed pivots. They cannot convert a pivot failure into PASS.
mutation_scope: Only a2_piezo_check_m.f90 and this new protocol; no source-model, material, BC, solver, old result or original protocol mutation.
